title: Service requests flow (Gap Analysis and Implementation Support)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 05 Nov 2026 · Happy path only · Prepared by QA
intro: Requests used: SR-2026-125 (Gap Analysis) and SR-2026-126 (Implementation Support), workspace [QA] W9 R4 ISO 22301:2012 (Assisted), Customer Admin Kevin Lin, consultant Chen Wei from the Marketplace. Red boxes and labels were added for this document.

Roles: the Customer Admin (Customer Portal) creates the request and grants workspace access; the SGS Consultant (SGS Portal, Assigned to me) accepts and does the work; the SGS Admin (SGS Portal) only follows the requests, read only.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Service Requests > New request
steps.what: Create a Gap Analysis request in three steps: details, consultant, review and submit.
body: Step 1: service, workspace and a message to the consultant. Step 2: consultant source Marketplace (the consultant accepts first) or My consultants (work starts at once). Step 3: review, then Submit request.
shots: Step 2: consultant chosen from the Marketplace.
Step 3: review and the next statuses.

steps.result: SGS Admin sees every consulting request, read only.
body: The SGS Admin does not assign the consultant in this flow: the customer chose it. The SGS Admin page is read only.
shots: Requests > Service Requests: the new request.
Request detail for the SGS Admin, read only.

steps.what: Accept the request, agree the scope, then declare Ready to start.
steps.result: Status In discussion, then Ready to start.
body: Scope and commercial terms are agreed with the customer outside DTP while the request is In discussion.
shots: Assigned to me: the request. (The header then read "Operations Console"; it now reads "SGS Portal".)
Ready to start: waiting for the customer.

steps.result: Status In progress; the consultant gets read-only access to the workspace.
shots: Confirm Workspace access dialog: Confirm & Start Service.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Assigned to me > SR-xxxx
steps.what: Add findings, upload the deliverable, then Request completion.
steps.result: Findings and report shared with the customer; completion requested.
body: A Gap Analysis needs a deliverable (PDF or Word) before completion. Findings stay drafts until the deliverable is shared.
shots: Add finding: requirement, finding, level and justification. (The header then read "Operations Console"; it now reads "SGS Portal".)

steps.what: Read the findings and report, then Confirm completion.
steps.result: Status Completed; the consultant's access ends.
shots: The customer sees the deliverable and the findings.

steps.result: Comment saved; the consultant is told.
body: Here the comment was posted after completion; posting while In progress works the same way.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Service Requests > New request
steps.what: Create an Implementation Support request (same three steps).

steps.where: SGS Consultant: SGS Portal > Assigned to me · then Customer Admin: Customer Portal > SR-xxxx
steps.what: Accept, Ready to start, then the customer grants access and starts.
shots: Consultant declared Ready to start. (The header then read "Operations Console"; it now reads "SGS Portal".)
After Grant Workspace Access & Start: In progress.

steps.where: SGS Consultant: SGS Portal > SR-xxxx > Comments · then Customer Admin: Customer Portal > SR-xxxx
steps.what: Discuss in the request comments, Request completion, customer confirms.
body: Implementation Support has no findings or deliverable; the discussion is kept in the request comments. DTP asks to confirm before a comment is sent.

tables.heading: Request statuses
rows: Waiting for the Marketplace consultant to accept or decline.
Scope and terms are agreed outside DTP.
Waiting for the customer to grant workspace access.
The consultant works with read-only access to the workspace.
Shown in the timeline; the customer confirms.

limitations: On the SGS environment, sign-in is through Microsoft Entra; the test environment uses a mock sign-in.
Email notifications depend on the SGS SMTP; on the test environment they go to Mailpit only.
Requests to 'My consultants' skip Accept and Ready to start: they start In progress when submitted. Not shown here.
blocked: Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Each role can sign in to its portal through Entra.
Emails for new request, accept, request completion, completed.
On the test environment mail goes to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Customer and consultant receive the emails for each status change.
